notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Great Oak Guardian.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Great Oak Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.
